nom: PEACH & LILY Glass Skin Face Polisher

segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers describe sensitive skin and report the polisher cleanses without irritation, dryness, or new breakouts, with several calling it their first physical exfoliant that doesn't sting.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-combination skin say it cleans and exfoliates without leaving skin stripped or overly dry, though one dry-based reviewer found it not exfoliating enough for her rough skin type.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-T-zone skin report it helps keep pores and congestion in check and preps skin well for makeup.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (oily/normal, sensitive-combo) skin describe it as gentle yet effective, keeping pores clearer with regular use.
segments.mature: Older reviewers (50s-60s+) report smoother, firmer-looking skin and reduced dryness even with infrequent use, with one noting lightened dark spots and reduced redness over time.
segments.normal: A reviewer with already-good skin found gentle physical exfoliation useful occasionally but did not notice major changes in pore size or brightness.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers report firmer, better-looking skin and one notes lightened dark spots and less redness with continued use, though one reviewer felt no major change in brightness or pore size.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dehydrated or dry-combo skin report the product cleans without stripping or excessive dryness, though one reviewer noted her skin felt tight once dry.
concerns.redness: One long-term mature-skin user reports her redness has become much less noticeable, though still occasionally present.
concerns.barrier: Several sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation or compromised feeling after use, describing it as non-stripping; one combination-skin reviewer felt her skin was sometimes less balanced on days she used it.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her dark spots are lighter after continued use, and another notes reduced acne scarring.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, clearer pores, and improvement over weeks to months (including one combining it with salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide); one reviewer reports increased acne and new bumps after about three months of use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-oily reviewers report a cleaner, less congested T-zone and smoother makeup application after use.

aspects.libelle: Not exfoliating enough for rough skin base

extraits.texte: I love Peach and Lily's matcha pudding moisturizer, so I had high hopes for this. Unfortunately, all it did was cause even more acne even after around 3 months of usage. I used to have clear skin with just some clogged pores on my chin, but now I have zits and tiny bumps all over my chin.

I have very sensitive skin and have struggled with acne since I was a teen (I'm 27). I also struggle with having really dry patches of skin and then some oily areas as well. This exfoliator hasn't itritated my skin or caused any more acne to surface other than my isual breakouts. The reason why i live this product is because many exfoliators I've used have left my face feeling very dry and stripped of all my natural oils. It leaves my skin feeling slightly moisturized but not an excessive amount. I think this would be great for all skin types!

Purchased during Ulta's annual 21-day sale. It's one of my favorite new finds. Lathers easily and leaves my skin clean without feeling dry. I have extremely sensitive skin and struggle to find/try new products that work. I've been using this daily for over a month and my 45yo dry-to-combo skin takes it well without issue.

I've been using this every evening since last summer, and I think it's really helped keep my pores clear! I have combination (oily/normal) sensitive dehydrated (not dry) skin that's somewhat acne-prone (hormonally). Absolutely love this. A little bit goes a long way, so one bottle lasts me for 8-9 months.

This is the best facial exfoliant I have ever used. I love the whole glass skin line. My 52 year old skin has never looked better! I used to struggle with redness, enlarged pores, and dark spots. I still have a bit of redness occasionally, but very little. My dark spots are there, but much lighter now. Peach & Lily glass skin collection plus their matcha pudding cream are my go to skin products now.

My skincare routine was decent but lacking. I stumbled upon Peach and Lily, and with their recommendation I purchased this exfoliator. Im ecstatic because my skin instantly reacted positively to it. I have acne prone skin that clogs easily. I believe the exfoliant rice and salicylic acid combo was exactly what my skin needed. Paired with the glass serum , the combo have made it to my HG list.

Unless I read this wrong and it is not an exfoliator, which is what I bought it for, this is a lovely, moisturizing cleanser with gentle scrub balls, but it is not a polisher. Being someone who has rough skin as my base, a buff and puff exfoliator does not work on me. If you have creamy skin, this may work great for you.
